ent_algorithm_ppo.name: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)
ent_algorithm_ppo.summary: A policy-gradient reinforcement-learning algorithm that constrains update steps to avoid destructive policy changes and improve sample efficiency.
ent_algorithm_ppo.body:
## Overview

Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is a policy gradient reinforcement learning algorithm that improves sample efficiency by limiting the step size of policy updates to avoid destructive changes. It belongs to the algorithm type within information entities and has become the de facto default choice in fields such as humanoid robot motion control and manipulation skill learning. What PPO truly changes is not the theoretical framework of reinforcement learning, but rather it transforms policy gradient methods from being "fragile and difficult to tune" into "stable and reproducible" engineering tools.

ent_algorithm_active_set_method.name: Active-Set Method for Quadratic Programming
ent_algorithm_active_set_method.summary: An iterative algorithm for solving QPs that maintains a working set of active constraints and solves equality-constrained subproblems until optimality conditions are satisfied.
ent_algorithm_active_set_method.body:
## Overview
The Active-Set Method is a class of iterative algorithms for solving Quadratic Programming (QP) problems. Its core idea is to maintain a "working set" (i.e., the set of constraints currently considered active) and progressively approach the optimal solution by repeatedly solving subproblems that contain only equality constraints. What it truly changes is not the speed of solving a single QP, but rather the transformation of "optimization with inequality constraints" from a theoretical construct into an engineering-feasible iterative process—this is the fundamental reason it is widely adopted in real-time scenarios such as model predictive control and whole-body dynamics control in robotics.

ent_algorithm_sac.name: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC)
ent_algorithm_sac.summary: An off-policy actor-critic reinforcement-learning algorithm that maximizes expected return while also maximizing policy entropy for exploration.
ent_algorithm_sac.body:
## Overview
Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is an off-policy actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithm that maximizes expected return while simultaneously maximizing policy entropy to promote exploration. By incorporating an entropy regularization term into the objective function, it establishes an explicit balance mechanism between exploration and exploitation, making it a benchmark algorithm with excellent stability and sample efficiency for continuous action-space control tasks.
